candidates.name: Interior Resource Supply Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage says it supplies, installs and services acoustical ceilings and bathroom partitions; lists toilet partitions and restroom accessories among its products.
candidates.reason: A specialty contractor in Dearborn that says it installs bathroom partitions and works for commercial construction firms. It also supplies partitions itself, so there is a buy-around risk.
red_flags: Distributor that also sells toilet partitions (buy-around risk)
Listed email appears to be a named person's address; no project photos seen

license.name: Interior Resource Supply Inc
license.registry: City of Detroit BSEED contractor license and registration (no public online lookup found; registrations run through the city's Accela portal). Michigan LARA licensee search (aca-prod.accela.com/LARA) checked as the state source.
license.note: Company site (https://interiorresource.org/, read 2026-11-19) describes a distributor and specialty contractor that provides, installs and services acoustical ceilings and bathroom partitions; street address in Dearborn, MI, and the site describes it as a Detroit, Michigan supplier. Public company phone: 734.968.4747, office 313.584.4399. The site shows no license numbers. State: according to the area rule, Michigan has no state license for this work. LARA's licensee search form (https://aca-prod.accela.com/LARA/GeneralProperty/PropertyLookUp.aspx?isLicensee=Y&TabName=APO) loads without sign-in, but results come only through an interactive ASP.NET postback, so no automated lookup was possible. City: search results for the BSEED contractor license page (https://detroitmi.gov/departments/buildings-safety-engineering-and-environmental-department-bseed/bseed-divisions/construction-inspection/bseed-contractor-license-application) say Detroit requires contractors doing certain construction work to be state-licensed, registered with the city each year and insured. Both the detroitmi.gov page and its training.detroitmi.gov mirror returned HTTP 403 to automated access. No public registry of registered contractors was found. Still open: whether partition installation is a covered category, and the company's registration status. Confirm both with BSEED Construction Division at (313) 224-3202 (number taken from search results, not read on the page). Not checked: Michigan business entity search.

candidates.partition_evidence: Sells partitions, parts and accessories and links to DIY installation instructions; no installation service stated.
candidates.reason: An online partition and parts seller (a competitor, not an installer). Nothing on its site says it installs partitions.

candidates.name: Robert Brooke & Associates, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Sells bathroom partitions and parts and offers installation instructions; no installation service.
candidates.reason: A commercial hardware and partition supplier. It offers installation guidance only, not installation, and it competes with us on partition sales.

candidates.name: Partitions and Stalls

candidates.reason: This is Robert Brooke & Associates' partition web store, so it is a duplicate of that entry. It sells partitions but doesn't install them.

candidates.name: ProDryers Commercial Restroom Supply

candidates.reason: An online restroom product distributor with no installation service.
